_how_it_works: Each dashboard section is fed by Sprinklr widget payloads saved in widgets/. Paste a payload into the chat with the section name, or save it as widgets/<file> and update 'edited'.

topic_totals.title: Mentions, potential reach, media value
topic_totals.needs: Topic; Mentions, Overall reach (shown as potential reach), Reach count, EMV. All sources.
topic_totals.run: per period: 7D, 30D, 90D, YTD with comparison periods

topic_share.title: Share of voice
topic_share.needs: Topic; Mentions. All sources. Cross-checks the totals.
topic_share.run: per period: 7D, 30D, 90D, YTD with comparison periods

sentiment_topic.title: Sentiment
sentiment_topic.needs: Topic and Sentiment, uncategorised excluded; Mentions.
sentiment_topic.run: per period: 7D, 30D, 90D, YTD with comparison periods
sentiment_topic.note: Also feeds the negative sentiment share on the leader cards: negative mentions over all categorised mentions.

country_topic.title: Coverage by country
country_topic.needs: Country and Topic; Mentions. Unknown country excluded.
